objective: User-selected higher concurrent throughput on the existing local Podman named volume; no new production SLO
hypothesis: Completed dispatch futures can refill freed slots sooner than the fixed 250ms sleep; a bounded 50ms follow-up window catches successor admissions without continuously polling during slow/unresolved work
rejectedDirection: Inline admission dispatch rejected before implementation: synchronous durable.start can block HTTP isolation slots and the 202 admission response
order: For each concurrency, block and cell, AB when (block+cellIndex) is even, BA otherwise; rotate cell traversal by block; each pair is adjacent

selection.everyRound: Original output/read/attempt/cleanup contracts and warm p95, throughput, PSS budgets pass
selection.controlRequests: internal pending plus internal dispatch; includes all 8 warmups and 32 measured jobs; both packages use identical Python HTTP observation
selection.retainOnlyIf: All paired criteria plus original full cost matrix, relevant product regression, dispatcher fault tests and exact-package lifecycle pass; otherwise restore both original supervisors and retain failed evidence

boundaries: No TypeScript, native, SQLite, capability, lease, deadline, status polling or physical-attempt changes
Run baseline and candidate sequentially using their exact packaged deploy.py modules, whole namespaces on the same named volume
No statistical significance or dedicated-host claim
Paired observer counts traffic but final uninstrumented full matrix decides cost acceptance
